        "All owned hunks across 17 raw changed paths and 9 logical files were read.         "verify_docs joins text from existing registered paths.         "The actual comm register replaces generator.verifications with this local sequence. No claim is made that the local comm page is thereby registered with the local verifier; the upstream module/initialization pairing remains bounded.",

A missing attribute heading can be satisfied by another registered file; the local page alone does not establish complete documentation.         "The Markdown conversion preserves the Thunderbird task-kind catalogue, cron YAML directives, loader include/exclude examples, parameter descriptions and index/toctree. transforms/index changes its loading reference to ../loading.
